name: Adnan Adrian Wood-Smith
bio: An educator, coach, and community leader focused on helping Muslim professionals bring greater clarity, purpose, and spiritual depth into their daily lives. As Founder of Prophetic Community, he works at the intersection of faith, leadership, and personal development; supporting individuals and communities in building more intentional, grounded lives.

name: Akbar Afzal Jessani
bio: Akbar Jessani is the CEO of Universal Shipping Inc., a seasoned leader with deep expertise in 3PL warehousing, distribution, trucking, and freight forwarding. With over 18 years of experience in internal audit and risk compliance, Akbar blends strategic insight with operational excellence to drive sustainable growth and client success. As an AMCOB Ambassador in Irvine, he brings his commitment to innovation, collaboration, and integrity to help advance AMCOB’s mission and foster meaningful connections across the business community.

name: Ayesha Qureshi
bio: Ayesha Qureshi, AMCOB Ambassador in Detroit and proud AMCOB member, is a dynamic entrepreneur and the driving force behind two ventures — Q Line Media and Cultured Cuties. As a 2x founder, she’s passionate about helping businesses thrive through strategic, results-driven marketing rooted in transparency and strong communication. With her creative energy, entrepreneurial insight, and deep community commitment, Ayesha actively contributes to advancing AMCOB’s mission. She continues to uplift and connect Muslim professionals across Detroit, amplifying our collective impact with purpose and heart.

name: Brian Mcleroy
bio: Brian McElroy serves as AMCOB’s Ambassador in Orlando, Florida. A valued member of the AMCOB community, Brian brings extensive experience in cybersecurity, business strategy, and leadership to this role.As Ambassador, he helps strengthen AMCOB’s presence across Central Florida, fostering collaboration among members and serving as a local point of contact for entrepreneurs and professionals in the region.Members in and around Orlando are encouraged to connect with Brian to explore opportunities, exchange insights, and build meaningful business connections.

name: Haris Ahmed
bio: Harris Ahmed is your go-to strategist for launching high-performing organizations within 90 days. With a dynamic and agile approach, he aligns practical methodologies to your strategy and capabilities, ensuring rapid and effective business leadership.

name: Humayun Kabeer
role: Senior Manager, Planned Giving and Capital Campaigns
company: Helping Hand for Relief and Development
bio: Humayun A. Kabeer is an AMCOB Ambassador in Boston, MA, and a dedicated member committed to fostering the growth of the Muslim community. As a Senior Manager at Helping Hand USA and a CFRM-certified professional, Humayun specializes in Planned Giving and Endowment initiatives, where his strategic leadership has driven double-digit growth and established a legacy of generosity. His expertise in donor relations and strategic marketing has played a key role in amplifying participation in community-driven programs, ensuring their long-term impact. In his role as an AMCOB Ambassador, Humayun is passionate about empowering Muslim professionals, forging meaningful local and national connections, and contributing to AMCOB’s mission of collective success.

name: Ihssane Leckey
bio: Ihssane Leckey, a dynamic force driving change! As the Founder & CEO, of DEI Firebrand, and Racial and Social Justice Advocate, Ihssane fearlessly champions diversity, equity, and inclusion. A Motivational Speaker, Unapologetically Progressive leader, and former Candidate for U.S. Congress, she brings a powerful voice to the forefront. A dedicated Community Organizer, Ihssane sparks conversations that inspire transformation. Get ready to be motivated and energized by her impactful journey and unwavering commitment to progress!

name: Iyas Seidan
bio: Iyas Seidan helps companies expand into the MEAI region by unlocking growth through transformative strategies. With 15+ years of expertise across People & Culture, Organizational Development, and Operational Excellence, he champions innovative solutions that drive change, elevate performance, and foster inclusive workplace cultures.

name: Kamal Solaiman
bio: Kamal is a dynamic entrepreneur and real estate investor with over 30 years of top-tier business experience. He’s navigated everything from Fortune 50 giants to startups, mastering strategy, operations, and IT along the way. Now focused on residential real estate investing and entrepreneurship consulting, Kamal combines his broad expertise and entrepreneurial mindset to drive growth and success.

name: Mohamed Bakerywala
bio: Mohammad Bakerywala, a seasoned business leader with a proven track record of success in both corporate and entrepreneurial settings. With a keen eye for talent and a strategic approach, Mohammad excels in achieving business objectives and driving growth even in resource-constrained environments. His strong analytical skills and financial acumen contribute to his ability to navigate challenges and guide individuals and companies toward success. Experienced in team management, he builds morale and motivates teams to consistently deliver high-level performance and results.

name: Noor Hamid
bio: Noor Hamid is a talented Interior Designer, a committed AMCOB member, and our proud AMCOB Ambassador in Tampa. She brings a unique blend of creativity, passion, and purpose to everything she does — both in her professional work and in her dedication to uplifting the Muslim business community. As an Ambassador, Noor actively champions AMCOB’s mission and plays a key role in strengthening local connections and creating meaningful engagement in her region.

name: Sajjad Chowdhry
bio: A visionary C-level executive, entrepreneur, and venture builder on a relentless quest to inspire positive change. Grounded in unwavering values, driven by visionary leadership, and guided by the power of first principles and systems thinking. This trailblazer is redefining success by setting new standards for purpose-driven innovation and sustainable impact.
